description: This file defines the WishlistViewModel class, which manages the state and operations related to a user's wishlist in a Flutter application. It interacts with a wishlist repository to load, toggle, and clear wishlist data, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: WishlistViewModel
classes.description: A view model class extending ChangeNotifier to manage wishlist data and state, providing methods to load wishlist, toggle items, and handle errors.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the wishlist data, initializing it if empty, and manages loading/error states.

methods.name: isWishlistedSync
methods.description: Checks synchronously if a product ID is in the wishlist.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Asynchronously toggles the wishlist status for a given product ID, updating the wishlist state.

methods.name: clearError
methods.description: Clears any error messages and notifies listeners.
